notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
